# Pramp

> > Pramp is a peer-to-peer mock interview platform for technical and product management interview preparation, now part of Exponent Practice.

Pramp enables developers and product managers to practice live mock interviews with peers across multiple domains including data structures & algorithms, system design, frontend development, behavioral questions, data science, and product management. The platform uses a peer-to-peer model where users take turns interviewing each other.

## Key Topics

- Mock interviews
- Peer-to-peer practice
- Technical interviews
- Coding interviews
- Data structures & algorithms
- System design
- Frontend interviews
- Behavioral interviews
- Interview preparation
- Whiteboarding
- Product management
- Data science
- Exponent Practice
- Job search strategies
- Coding practice

## Technical Interview Practice

- [Data Structures & Algorithms Interview](https://www.pramp.com/dev/uc-data-structures-and-algorithms): Data structures & algorithms interview practice with whiteboarding
- [System Design Interview](https://www.pramp.com/dev/uc-system-design): System design interview prep with coding practice questions
- [Frontend Interview Practice](https://www.pramp.com/dev/uc-frontend): Frontend interview practice with peer-to-peer mock interviews
- [Data Science Interview](https://www.pramp.com/dev/uc-data-science): Data science interview questions with peer-to-peer practice

## Behavioral & Product Management

- [Behavioral Interview Practice](https://www.pramp.com/dev/uc-behavioral): Behavioral interview preparation with peer practice sessions
- [Product Management Interview](https://www.pramp.com/pm/uc-product-case-study): PM interview prep with product case study mock interviews
